d.ko: Plunge into a new world with a completely foreign language in this romantic, yuri isekai visual novel about the struggles of communication and forging connection. Experience life in a foreign land. Enjoy a sweet, heartwarming romance. Learn Esperanto.
d.en: Plunge into a new world with a completely foreign language in this romantic, yuri isekai visual novel about the struggles of communication and forging connection. Experience life in a foreign land. Enjoy a sweet, heartwarming romance. Learn Esperanto.
d.zh: 本作中出现的异世界语言“百合语（Juliamo）”对应现实中实际存在的人工语言“世界语（Esperanto）”。这是一个讲述了误闯异世界的少女和另一位少女相遇的纯百合ADV游戏。
